$comment: Published golden data (ADR-0013 D8, ADR-0014 D3). Anything matching 'immutable' may be ADDED but never modified, deleted, renamed or type-changed. 'appendOnlyJson' files may only grow: every existing key keeps its value, arrays keep their existing prefix. Draft goldens (test/golden/drafts/**) are deliberately not listed. Glob syntax: '*' is one path segment part, '**' any number of segments. Edit this file only to ADD protection; a PR that weakens it is a gate change and needs devops-sre review.
